item.title:
AI Guide Makes Product Launch Videos Easy for Beginners!
Need your founder on camera for a launch video, but no time to shoot?
Here's how this Pexo launch video was made.
item.description:
AI Guide Makes Product Launch Videos Easy for Beginners!
Need your founder on camera for a launch video, but no time to shoot?
Here's how this Pexo launch video was made.
We gave Pexo one photo of @evanLiaoQ and a short voice recording.
Pexo learned his face, cloned his voice, and read the whole script with it. Every line came back with timestamps, so the captions and graphics lined up on their own.
Since everything is generated from that one photo, he looks the same in every scene. We never booked a studio or did a second take.
